author: Totally Not Mark
description:
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/TotallyNotMark

Remaking Goku & Beerus' first clash on King Kai's planet had been on my bucket list for many years and finally we managed to make good on that goal! The reaction has been overwhelming and I cannot describe how grateful we all are for your support. 

Today I wanted to break down all the creative decisions we made to bring this to life and outline what the future holds for our budding independent fan animation studio! What's next? Stick around to find out!
title: Goku vs Beerus - Behind The Animation & What's Next
